verdict.rationale: v0.app claims 'Fine-tune every detail with visual controls and live preview' (v0-docs-7), suggesting some direct-manipulation UI, but nearly all other documentation describes chat/prompt-driven generation and iteration cycles rather than click-to-select element editing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or demo of selecting an element on canvas and editing its text/style/layout inline, independent corroboration that this bypasses the prompt loop, and detail on what 'visual controls' actually cover.
